title: IT Specialist
description:
**Position Title:** IT Specialist

**Location:** Kochi, Kerala

We are looking for a proactive and responsible IT Specialist with 1–3 years of experience who takes ownership of infrastructure, identifies potential issues early, and continuously works to improve the reliability, security, and performance of IT systems.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Proactively monitor servers, networks, cloud platforms, virtualization, and security infrastructure.
* Perform regular health checks, preventive maintenance, patching, backups, and performance optimization.
* Identify potential failures, security risks, and capacity issues before they impact business operations.
* Configure and support Windows/Linux servers, networking, firewalls, VPNs, and virtualization platforms.
* Support Microsoft Azure and AWS environments, along with backup and disaster recovery activities including identity and access management - MFA, provisioning, same-day offboarding, access reviews.
* Troubleshoot infrastructure issues, perform RCA, and implement permanent solutions for recurring problems.
* Automate repetitive tasks using PowerShell, Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar tools.
* Maintain accurate infrastructure documentation, SOPs, and configuration records.
* Work with senior engineers and internal teams on infrastructure deployments, upgrades, and improvement projects.
* Continuously identify opportunities to improve IT operations, security, efficiency, and automation.

**Requirements**

* 1–3 years of experience in IT Infrastructure, System Administration, or IT Operations.
* Good hands-on knowledge of Windows/Linux, networking, virtualization, and cloud technologies.
* Understanding of TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPNs, firewalls, and basic routing/switching.
* Exposure to VMware, Hyper-V,proxmox, Azure, and/or AWS.
* Basic scripting or automation knowledge is preferred.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Good communication, documentation, and coordination skills.

**Ideal Candidate**

Someone who doesn't wait for problems to happen. You should actively monitor systems, identify risks, take preventive action, automate where possible, and continuously look for ways to make the IT environment more reliable and efficient.

Please share your resume to careers@skolte.com

Pay: From ₹28,000.00 per month

title: Network Engineer
description:
Experience: 2–5 Years

Location: Kochi, Kerala

Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a skilled and hands-on Network Engineer to manage and maintain the company's IT infrastructure, network, servers, cybersecurity systems, hardware, cloud environment, email systems, and IT assets.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring network availability, server uptime, data security, system performance, backups, and smooth day-to-day IT operations across the office and plant locations.

Key Responsibilities

1. Server Management

Configure, maintain, monitor, and troubleshoot in-house rack servers.

Hands-on experience with Windows Server installation, configuration, administration, and troubleshooting.

Manage Active Directory, user accounts, permissions, Group Policy, DNS, DHCP, and file servers.

Monitor server performance, storage capacity, system health, and uptime.

Manage server upgrades, patches, firmware updates, and preventive maintenance.

Maintain proper server documentation and configuration records.

2. Network Infrastructure

Configure and maintain LAN/WAN, switches, routers, Wi-Fi access points, and network infrastructure.

Troubleshoot network connectivity, speed, IP conflicts, DNS issues, and other network problems.

Manage VLANs, IP addressing, routing, DHCP, DNS, and network access.

Monitor network performance and identify potential failures or bottlenecks.

Ensure reliable connectivity between office, factory, and remote locations.

3. Sophos Firewall & Security

Hands-on experience with Sophos Firewall configuration and administration.

Configure firewall policies, NAT, VPN, web filtering, application control, and security rules.

Monitor firewall logs and network traffic for suspicious activities.

Configure and maintain endpoint security and antivirus solutions.

Implement appropriate cybersecurity measures to protect company systems and data.

4. Cloud Infrastructure

Configure, maintain, and monitor cloud servers and cloud infrastructure.

Manage cloud-based virtual machines, storage, backups, networking, and access controls.

Monitor cloud server performance, availability, and resource utilization.

Coordinate cloud migration, upgrades, and troubleshooting when required.

Experience with platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, or other cloud environments will be an advantage.

5. System & Hardware Maintenance

Install, configure, upgrade, and troubleshoot desktops, laptops, printers, scanners, servers, and other IT hardware.

Diagnose hardware failures and coordinate repairs/replacements.

Manage system upgrades, RAM/SSD/HDD replacements, operating system installations, and software deployment.

Ensure all systems are properly configured and maintained.

6. Email & Communication Systems

Manage company email accounts, user access, distribution groups, and email configurations.

Configure email accounts on desktops, laptops, and mobile devices.

Troubleshoot email delivery, authentication, spam, and security-related issues.

Manage email security, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC where applicable.

Coordinate with email/cloud service providers for technical issues.

7. IT Asset Management

Maintain a complete and updated IT asset register for computers, servers, networking equipment, printers, software licenses, and other IT assets.

Track asset allocation, movement, warranty, AMC, repairs, and replacement schedules.

Maintain proper documentation for IT purchases and asset handover.

Monitor software licenses and ensure compliance.

8. Backup & Data Protection

Implement and monitor regular server, system, and critical data backups.

Periodically verify backup integrity and restoration capability.

Maintain appropriate backup schedules and retention policies.

Support disaster recovery and business continuity requirements.

9. User & IT Support

Provide day-to-day technical support to employees for hardware, software, network, email, and connectivity issues.

Create and manage user accounts and access permissions.

Troubleshoot Windows, Microsoft Office, printers, network drives, VPN, and other common IT issues.

Maintain an IT support/request tracking system and ensure timely resolution.

10. IT Security & Compliance

Ensure systems are protected against malware, viruses, unauthorized access, and other cybersecurity threats.

Implement security patches and regular updates.

Manage user access, passwords, permissions, and endpoint security.

Conduct periodic checks of firewall, antivirus, server, and network security.

Develop and maintain IT security policies and SOPs.

11. IT Documentation & SOPs

Prepare and maintain SOPs for server management, network operations, backups, cybersecurity, user access, and IT support.

Maintain updated network diagrams, IP address records, server configurations, and firewall configurations.

Maintain technical documentation for all critical IT infrastructure.

12. Vendor & AMC Management

Coordinate with external IT vendors, hardware suppliers, internet service providers, cloud providers, and AMC/service partners.

Manage service calls, warranty claims, AMC requirements, and technical escalations.

Evaluate technical requirements and provide recommendations to management before IT purchases.

Additional Responsibilities

Monitor internet bandwidth and coordinate with ISPs for connectivity issues.

Manage VPN connectivity for remote users and locations.

Support CCTV/NVR and other network-connected devices where required.

Assist with IT infrastructure setup for new offices, factories, and project locations.

Plan network and server infrastructure for future expansion.

Maintain minimum downtime and ensure quick resolution of critical IT incidents.

Participate in periodic IT audits and infrastructure reviews.

Ensure IT systems are properly secured, documented, and maintained.

Required Qualifications & Experience

Bachelor's/Diploma qualification in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field.

2–5 years of hands-on experience in network and system administration.

Proven experience in in-house rack server configuration and maintenance.

Strong experience with Windows Server administration.

Hands-on experience with Sophos Firewall.

Good knowledge of LAN, WAN, TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VPN, VLAN, routers, and switches.

Experience in system hardware troubleshooting and maintenance.

Experience in firewall, antivirus, endpoint security, and cybersecurity.

Experience in cloud server configuration and maintenance.

Experience in email administration and troubleshooting.

Good knowledge of IT asset management and documentation.

Preferred Skills

Microsoft Windows Server / Active Directory

Sophos Firewall & Endpoint Security

Microsoft 365 / Exchange Online

Azure / AWS / Cloud Infrastructure

VMware / Hyper-V virtualization

Backup & Disaster Recovery

VPN, VLAN, DNS & DHCP

Network Monitoring Tools

CCTV/NVR & IP-based systems

IT Asset Management

Cybersecurity & Endpoint Management

Key Personal Attributes

Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.

Hands-on and practical approach to IT infrastructure.

Ability to work independently and take ownership of IT operations.

Good communication and coordination skills.

Ability to respond quickly to critical network/server issues.

Good documentation and reporting skills.

Willingness to support IT requirements across office and factory locations.

Key Performance Areas

Network Uptime | Server Uptime | Cybersecurity | Backup Reliability | IT Asset Management | Incident Resolution Time | System Availability | Network Performance | User Support | IT Documentation

title: Controls Engineer
description:
**ABOUT RADIC AUTOMATION LLP**

Radic Automation LLP is a Kochi-based engineering company delivering industrial automation and digitization solutions across marine, defence, automobile, packaging, manufacturing, water and utilities verticals. We engineer automation and digital systems that bridge the gap between traditional industrial operations and the future of digital enterprises. We are driven by a dynamic team of engineers capable of executing highly complex engineering projects from concept to deployment.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for a hands-on Controls Engineer with strong fundamentals in industrial automation and control systems. You will be responsible for the development, integration, testing, and commissioning of automation solutions across diverse platforms — working closely with lead engineers and contributing to the full project lifecycle from design to deployment.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Technical Execution**

* Develop, configure, test, and commission PLC, HMI, and SCADA applications on-site in accordance with project specifications and design documents.
* Implement motion control solutions involving VFDs and servo systems, with a strong understanding of underlying control principles.
* Integrate automation systems with field devices and third-party systems using standard industrial communication protocols.
* Troubleshoot and resolve hardware, software, and communication issues across automation platforms.
* Plan and execute FAT prior to site deployment and SAT post-commissioning.
* Support integration of automation systems with cloud platforms and data management tools.
* Provide post-deployment service support to completed projects, including remote and on-site assistance.

**Documentation**

* Prepare and maintain complete project documentation including test protocols, I/O lists, user manuals, application notes, site reports, and as-built records.
* Adhere to coding standards, engineering procedures, and documentation practices defined by the team.

**QUALIFICATIONS**

**Education**

* B.Tech / B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering.

**Experience**

* 3-4 years of hands-on experience in industrial automation, with demonstrated proficiency in PLC, HMI/SCADA programming and commissioning, with a minimum of 2 years in executing projects end to end.
* Proven experience working on control systems with distributed architectures, motion control and protocol integration.
* Hands-on experience in control panel wiring, assembly, and troubleshooting.
* Experience in parts selection, control wiring design, and control panel design.
* Proven experience integrating automation systems with different types of sensors, actuators, control valves, motors, instruments, and other field devices.
* Exposure to industrial verticals such as marine, automobile, packaging, or pharma is an advantage.

**Technical Skills**

**Automation Hardware & Software**

* PLCs, HMIs, SCADA, VFDs, and servo systems from Siemens, Schneider Electric, Rockwell Automation, Mitsubishi Electric, and Phoenix Contact (proficient in minimum of any 2 OEM)
* Troubleshooting tools: Modscan, PuTTY, Docklight, Wireshark.

**Programming**

* Proficient in IEC 61131-3 languages: Ladder Diagram (LD), Function Block Diagram (FBD), and Structured Text (ST).
* Understanding of motion control programming — cam profiles, SVC, position and torque control.
* Scripting languages for integration and backend tasks.

**Communication Protocols**

* Modbus RTU/TCP, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, PROFIBUS, OPC-UA, MQTT, CC-Link, EtherCAT, CAN, RS232, and RS485.

**Engineering Documents**

* Ability to read and produce URS, FDS, DDS, P&ID, SLD, system architecture diagrams, panel drawings, cable schedules, I/O lists, user manuals, application notes, site reports and commissioning reports.

**Standards**

* Working knowledge of ISA-88, ISA-95, ISA-101, IEC 61131-3, IEC 62443, and functional safety concepts.

**Network & Cybersecurity**

* Good understanding of network architecture including network segmentation, managed switches, network gateways, and secure remote access implementation.

**Data Management**

* Familiarity with scripting languages for integration tasks. Knowledge of SQL and relational databases is an advantage.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to break down complex control challenges into clear, manageable tasks.
* Precise and unambiguous communicator — in documentation, client interactions, and within the team.
* Self-managed, organised, and motivated with a structured approach to execution.
* Willingness to travel for site commissioning and post-deployment service support.
* Committed to continuous learning and keeping up with evolving automation technologies.
* Collaborative mindset and good emotional intelligence.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* Hands-on exposure to complex, multi-sector automation and digitization projects.
* A technically rich environment with experienced engineers to learn from and grow with.
* Professional development through training, certifications, and international project opportunities.
* Competitive compensation with performance-linked incentives.
* A clear growth path towards lead and senior engineering roles.

title: IT Architect – Windows & Datacenter
description:
**Experience:** 10\+ Years preferred

**Availability:** Immediate / 1 month Notice Period

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a senior Microsoft Infrastructure Technical Architect with strong hands\-on expertise across enterprise Windows infrastructure, Active Directory, IIS, Microsoft SQL Server, Exchange Server, SCCM, Hyper\-V, VMware and associated datacenter technologies.

The role requires deep technical experience in designing, implementing, migrating, upgrading and troubleshooting mission\-critical on\-premise Microsoft infrastructure environments. The ideal candidate should have prior experience working with banking or financial\-services organizations in India, GCC or other international markets and be comfortable operating within highly controlled, security\-sensitive production environments.

This is a hands\-on architecture and delivery role and is best suited for candidates who have personally executed complex infrastructure migrations, upgrades, security implementations and DR projects.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Design, assess and implement enterprise Microsoft infrastructure solutions across Production, DR, UAT and Test environments.

\* Lead Windows Server installation, configuration, migration and upgrades, including Windows Server 2012/2016/2019/2022/2025 environments.

\* Perform infrastructure discovery, compatibility assessment, dependency mapping and migration planning.

\* Architect, administer and troubleshoot Active Directory, including Domain Controllers, DNS, DHCP, Group Policies, replication, FSMO roles, service accounts, authentication and security hardening.

\* Design, implement, migrate and troubleshoot Microsoft IIS environments supporting enterprise applications.

\* Support Microsoft SQL Server infrastructure, including installation, configuration, migration, upgrade, security, backup/recovery and high\-availability requirements.

\* Implement and support Microsoft Exchange Server environments, including migration, DAG and hybrid scenarios.

\* Manage and troubleshoot SCCM / Microsoft Configuration Manager for server and endpoint administration, patching and software deployment.

\* Design and support virtualization environments using Hyper\-V and VMware vSphere/ESXi.

\* Plan and execute OS migrations, application server migrations and infrastructure modernization projects.

\* Support application teams during platform migration, middleware upgrade and production cutover activities.

\* Design and implement Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity solutions, including replication, failover, recovery testing and DR drills.

\* Implement Windows infrastructure security controls including hardening, patching, vulnerability remediation, firewall policies, access controls, certificates and security baselines.

\* Troubleshoot complex issues spanning Windows OS, Active Directory, networking, firewalls, DNS, load balancers, databases, middleware and applications.

\* Prepare migration runbooks, rollback procedures, architecture documents, implementation procedures and operational handover documentation.

\* Participate in CAB/change\-management processes and execute controlled production cutovers.

\* Provide technical leadership to infrastructure engineers, application teams, security teams and third\-party vendors.

\* Microsoft Windows Server

\* Disaster Recovery implementation

\* Backup and restoration

\* Patch and vulnerability management

\* PowerShell administration and automation

\* Production cutover and rollback planning

Banking / Enterprise Experience

Candidates must have prior hands\-on experience delivering infrastructure projects within banks, financial institutions or similarly regulated enterprise environments.

**Experience should ideally include areas such as:**

\* Production infrastructure migration

\* Datacenter modernization

\* Windows Server upgrades

\* Active Directory migration or upgrade

\* Application and database platform migration

\* DR implementation and testing

\* Security hardening

\* Vulnerability remediation

\* High\-availability infrastructure

\* Change/CAB\-controlled production environments

\* Microsoft Azure
